## External-Agent Compliance Rules (auto-synced from skill_registry — ห้ามแก้มือในโซนนี้)

### ext-claim-flow (#184 v1.0)
CLAIM a task with: UPDATE platform.tasks SET status='in_progress', assigned_agent='<your-roster-name>' WHERE id='<uuid>'. Do NOT write mr_dev.audit_logs (or any other table) as a substitute for claiming — that bypasses the board and the Hard Gates entirely (real incident: antigravity, dev_log 2010). assigned_agent MUST equal your exact name in platform.ai_team_agents (case-sensitive) or the DB hard-rejects the claim.

### ext-identity-roster (#185 v1.0)
Before writing any DB row, make sure your tool is registered in platform.ai_team_agents. Use your EXACT roster name (case-sensitive) in tasks.assigned_agent, dev_logs.agent and agent_messages.sender. Unknown names on tasks->in_progress are hard-rejected; unknown names on dev_logs/agent_messages are recorded as compliance flags. Registering a new tool = INSERT one row into ai_team_agents first.

### ext-phase6-devlog (#186 v1.1)
When you finish a task, INSERT exactly one platform.dev_logs row linked by task_id. Use the task canonical project and your roster agent name; include problem, cause of at least 20 characters, solution, result, and ref_files. Write this dev_log before setting status=completed. Skipping Phase 6 leaves the work invisible to audit and the completion gate rejects it.

### ext-work-order (#187 v1.1)
Tasks with priority high/urgent (grade A/B) require context.work_order before status=in_progress with keys: task, constraints, out_of_scope, verification{command,expected}, commit_message, files[non-empty], endpoints[array], and learnings_checked[array of IDs read from platform.learnings; [] only after a relevant search finds none]. The DB trigger rejects incomplete work orders. Do not downgrade priority to dodge this audited gate.

### ext-task-id-trailer (#188 v1.0)
Every commit that is real work (not an autosave) must carry a git trailer line "Task-Id: <uuid>" pointing at its platform.tasks row — the same discipline as Claude's Co-Authored-By trailer. Commits with no Task-Id trailer and no entry in tasks.commit_refs are detected as orphan-commits and flagged (weekly audit-orphan-commits job).

### ext-git-author (#189 v1.0)
Each tool MUST configure its own distinct git author (git config user.name / user.email), e.g. cursor commits as "cursor", gemini as "gemini". When every tool commits under the shared host identity, orphan commits cannot be attributed to the tool that made them and the audit can only report at repo level. Set your author once before committing.

### rule-deploy-verify-hotfix (#201 v1.0)
Before every production deploy, run git log --all --contains <hotfix_hash> for all known security hotfix commits. If ANY hotfix is missing from the deploy branch, ABORT the deploy and escalate. This prevents feature branches from silently reverting security fixes (real incident: IDOR regression from Early Bird branch).

### rule-task-must-exist-in-db (#202 v1.0)
Every task that is agreed upon MUST be INSERTed into platform.tasks within 5 minutes. Local notes and session trackers are NOT a substitute. Tasks that exist only in local notes vanish after clear and become invisible to the team (real incident: 4 tasks lost for 6+ days).
